value.rationale: The primary 2023 paper explicitly motivates LR ordering of proportional-odds largest claims, a stronger actuarial/reliability comparison than its usual stochastic conclusions. The result supplies an exact classification across all positive odds, two occurrence probabilities, every size and every positive common baseline; the sharp lower-odds sample-size transition determines when higher claim frequency compensates for less severe individual claims in the likelihood-ratio sense. Its discrete no-claim atom makes ordinary continuous LR arguments insufficient. The scope is a naturally homogeneous portfolio, not an arbitrary narrow parameter slice or numerical lookup.
